title.narrative: African Activists for Climate Justice (AACJ) Project in Mozambique

description.narrative: The AACJ project seeks to ensure inclusive and human-rights based approach to climate justice in Mozambique, by working with a strong movement and a network of climate actors. It targets Indigenous People and Local communities in marginalized and climate change vulnerable communities, and their grassroot networks and Civil Society Organizations (CSOs), government actors and the private sector. It seeks to strengthen, influence, and inspire climate justice, by creating a platform where a diverse network of actors can proactively engage in decision-making, policy influencing and developing climate narratives for the realization of broad-based change.
